name: Chinese Names for Preset Maps
summary: Chinese map names with industry names based on native first-construction rules.
description:
Enable before starting a new game from a preset map, including Deluxe maps. Use the Simplified Chinese interface and let the simulation run briefly after loading. Towns and streets use China name lists; residents use Chinese-character names.

Industry names follow the verified native first-construction naming rules: the native nearest-town query, final resource naming prefix and localized industry description, then native direction/number collision rules. The construction and its associated station groups receive the same complete name. Only names change; industries are never created, demolished or rebuilt. Nameless subfacilities are never forcibly assigned names.

New games only. Old names and queues from earlier versions are not revised. Interrupted tasks started with this version can resume on load, then stop scanning when finished. There are no periodic map scans. Requires a map with towns; names are preserved when resources are unavailable or a special station needs the unsupported random extra-word collision branch. Standard native industries do not use that station branch. Independent custom station-group names are preserved.

Player nicknames, company names, custom line/vehicle names and map-selection titles are preserved. Does not operate in the map editor. Restart after updating and keep enabled for future Chinese name generation. Chinese place names replace the original names rather than transliterating them.

Cover art illustrates the function; actual appearance is determined by the game.

zh_CN.name: 预设地图中文名称
zh_CN.summary: 中文地名与人物名，产业参照原生首次取名规则。
zh_CN.description:
从豪华版等预设地图创建新游戏前启用，使用简体中文界面，进入地图后让游戏运行片刻。城市和街道使用中国名称库，人物使用汉字姓名。

产业参照已核实的原生首次取名规则：调用原生最近城市查询，读取最终资源命名模板和中文产业描述，再按原生方位、编号规则处理重名。产业建设主体与所属站点组使用同一个完整名称。只修改名称，不创建、拆除或重建产业；无独立名称的子设施不强制写入名称。

仅新开局。旧名称和旧版本队列不追改；本版本任务中断可随读档继续，完成后停止扫描，不做周期巡检。需要地图中存在城市；资源不可用或特殊站点进入尚不支持的随机附加词重名分支时保留原名并记日志。标准原生产业不使用该随机站点分支。独立自定义站点组名称保留原样。

保留玩家昵称、公司名、自定义线路和车辆名称，不修改地图选择菜单标题。在地图编辑器中不生效。更新后请重启游戏，继续游玩时保持启用。中国地名是替换名称，不是原地名的中文音译。

封面为功能示意，实际画面以游戏内为准。
